mapper.select: SELECT id, low_member_id, high_member_id, requester_id, status, version, expire_time, friend_since FROM member_friend WHERE FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member_friend(low_member_id, high_member_id, requester_id, request_msg, source_type, source_id, expire_time) SELECT LEAST(#{actorId}, #{peerId}), GREATEST(#{actorId}, #{peerId}), #{actorId}, #{message}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL 7 DAY) WHERE #{actorId} > 0 AND #{peerId} > 0 AND #{actorId} != #{peerId} AND CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(#{message})) BETWEEN 1 AND 60 AND #{sourceType} BETWEEN 0 AND 5
mapper.update: UPDATE member_friend SET status=2, acted_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, reject_reason=#{reason}, version=version+1 WHERE AND requester_id=#{peerId} AND #{reason} IN (1,2,9)

UPDATE member_friend SET status=3, acted_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version=version+1 WHERE AND status=1 AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND #{expectedVersion} >= 0 AND version < 9223372036854775807
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM member_friend_meta WHERE #{actorId} > 0 AND #{peerId} > 0 AND #{actorId} != #{peerId} AND ((member_id=#{actorId} AND friend_member_id=#{peerId}) OR (member_id=#{peerId} AND friend_member_id=#{actorId}))
